channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Terraform AWS Provider Continues Rapid Expansion as AWS Infrastructure Becomes More Complex
item.description: The Terraform AWS Provider continues its rapid evolution, with v6.62.0 adding support for new AWS capabilities while improving how Terraform understands and manages existing infrastructure. By Craig Risi (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Lambda recursive loop detection is now available in Europe Sovereign Cloud
item.description: AWS Lambda recursive loop detection is now supported for functions running in Europe Sovereign Cloud. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transform for .NET now generates unit tests for modernized code
item.description: Today, AWS announced that AWS Transform for .NET can automatically generate unit tests for the code it modernizes. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon API Gateway now supports 1 MB execution logs with configurable delivery destinations
item.description: Amazon API Gateway now supports configurable delivery destinations and larger log events for REST API execution logs. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda durable functions integrates with Pydantic AI
item.description: Today, AWS Lambda durable functions announces an integration with Pydantic AI , an open source framework for building AI agents in Python. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon MQ now supports RabbitMQ 4.3
item.description: Amazon MQ now supports RabbitMQ version 4.3 which adds quorum queue feature enhancements such as compaction, increased priority levels, native delayed retries, and graceful consumer timeouts. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Announcing second-generation single-rack AWS Outposts
item.description: Today, AWS announces the general availability of second-generation single-rack AWS Outposts, a self-contained 42U rack that integrates compute, storage and networking into a single compact unit purpose-built for workloads requiring low… (1 source: aws)
